SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
H. Q. Crime Branch Station,
REPORT
Date January 14, 1932.

Subject (in full) On C. H. Pragnell.

Made by D.S. 98 McPhee Forwarded by Supt. Quayle

Sir,
Reference to the attached Memorandum the undersigned
interviewed P. A. Cox Esq., Manager of the C.P.R. Co., re
Cecil Herbert Pragnell, and he stated that he had sent full
particulars of the case to the Hongkong Office and that up
to the present he had received no reply, and that he could
take no action without their sanction.
He further stated that Pragnell denies having deserted
the Empress of Japan, but states that he missed the ship.
C. H. Pragnell has been employed by the C.P.R. Co. for
12 years, but Mr. Cox stated that he knows nothing about his
character.
Mr. Cox questioned Pragnell as to who Cowdie was, who had
sent a cable to Shanghai from Vancouver inquiring about him,
and he stated that it was a Miss Cowdie, whom he was engaged
to marry.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
John McPhee
D.S. 98

事由（全称）关于 C. H. Pragnell。

由 98号警佐 McPhee 制作 经 Quayle 警司转呈

先生：
参照所附备忘录，卑职会见了加拿大太平洋铁路公司（C.P.R. Co.）经理 P. A. Cox 先生，谈及 Cecil Herbert Pragnell 一事。Cox 先生表示，他已将本案详情发送至香港办事处，但截至目前尚未收到回复，且在未获其批准前，他无法采取任何行动。
他还表示，Pragnell 否认自己从“日本皇后号”（Empress of Japan）擅离职守，而是称自己错过了该船。
C. H. Pragnell 受雇于加拿大太平洋铁路公司已达12年，但 Cox 先生表示对其品行一无所知。
Cox 先生询问 Pragnell Cowdie 是谁，此人曾从温哥华发电报至上海查询其下落。Pragnell 称那是一位 Cowdie 小姐，他已与其订婚。

此致
敬礼

John McPhee
98号警佐

SHANGHAI January 8th 1932.
315-1-C

（印：MUNICIPAL POLICE REGISTRY D. 3028 9. 1. 32.）

The Commissioner,
Criminal Investigation Department,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

Dear Sir:-

We have just been advised that C. Pragnell, Second Steward,
"Empress of Japan" deserted this steamer at Shanghai. The "Empress of
Japan" arrived Shanghai on Monday 9 AM, 4th instant, and sailed 6 AM
on Tuesday, 5th instant, for Vancouver via Japan Ports. We have furthermore
received the following cable from Vancouver this afternoon:

"HAVE YOU ANY TRACE PRAGNELL EMPRESS OF JAPAN
PLEASE CABLE RETURN CONFIRM 1186 BIDWELL VANCOUVER."

I shall be much obliged if you will have enquiries made and
endeavour to ascertain the whereabouts of this man and kindly report result.

Yours truly,

ASSISTANT ORIENTAL MANAGER.

尊敬的先生：

我方刚获悉，“日本皇后号”二等服务员 C. Pragnell 在上海从该轮擅离职守。“日本皇后号”于本月4日星期一上午9点抵达上海，并于本月5日星期二上午6点启航，经日本港口前往温哥华。此外，我们今天下午收到来自温哥华的如下电报：

“是否有 PRAGNELL 日本皇后号 的任何踪迹
请回电确认 1186 BIDWELL 温哥华。”

Date January 12, 1932.

Subject (in full) Report on Cecil Herbert Pragnell

Made by D.S. 98 McPhee Forwarded by Det. Supt. Quayle

Sir,
Reference to Daily Information Sheet No. 801 of 11-1-32,
under Miscellaneous C. Pragnell, second steward S. S. "Empress
of Japan", is reported to have deserted his steamer at
Shanghai on Tuesday, January 5, 1932. (S/B. D.3079)
On the 9-1-32 application No. 32/16 was received at the
Boarding House Section for the transfer of a Licence,
Restaurant (Beer at Meals) for premises situated at 1269
Bubbling Well Road, near Ferry Road, applied for by one
C. H. Pragnell, British Subject, premises situated at 1269
Bubling Well Road, at present licensed under the name of
Mr. M. Voitzman, Russian. C. H. Pragnell had no Police
record and the report was forwarded on the 9-1-32 from the
Boarding House Section.
date
This/the undersigned visited 1269 Bubbling Well Road, where
it was learned that C. H. Pragnell was residing in Room 205
of the Plaza Hotel. On receipt of the above information the
Plaza Hotel was visited and in Room 205 interviewed Cecil
Herbert Pragnell, age 31, British subject, on the pretence of
making enquiries re the transfer of the licence.
C. H. Pragnell stated that he arrived in Shanghai 8 days
ago from Vancouver on the S.S. "Empress of Japan", on which ship
he was employed as Chief Stewart, Second Class, and that he
had missed the above ship when it set sail from Shanghai.
C. H. Pragnell has a female residing with him at the
Plaza Hotel. He further stated that he was going to the
British Consulate this afternoon with some person from the
C.P.R. and if the Consulate would put his passport in order
he would remain in Shanghai, and conduct a restaurant at 1269

事由（全称）关于 Cecil Herbert Pragnell 的报告

由 98号警佐 McPhee 制作 经 侦探警司 Quayle 转呈

先生：
参照1932年1月11日第801号每日情报单，在“杂项”栏下，据报道，“日本皇后号”轮船二等服务员 C. Pragnell 于1932年1月5日星期二在上海从其所服务的轮船擅离职守。（S/B. D.3079）
1932年1月9日，寄宿管理处收到第32/16号申请，要求转让位于静安寺路1269号、近渡船路的一处场所的餐馆（用餐时供应啤酒）执照，申请人为英籍人士 C. H. Pragnell，该场所目前以俄国人 M. Voitzman 先生的名义持有执照。C. H. Pragnell 无警方记录，该报告已于1932年1月9日由寄宿管理处转呈。
日期
卑职走访了静安寺路1269号，获悉 C. H. Pragnell 居住在华懋公寓（Plaza Hotel）205室。收到上述信息后，卑职走访了华懋公寓，并在205室会见了 Cecil Herbert Pragnell，年龄31岁，英籍人士，借口是查询有关执照转让事宜。
C. H. Pragnell 声称，他于8天前从温哥华乘坐“日本皇后号”轮船抵达上海，他在该船上担任二等首席服务员，并称当该船从上海启航时，他错过了该船。
C. H. Pragnell 有一名女性与其同住于华懋公寓。他还表示，他将于今天下午与加拿大太平洋铁路公司的某人一同前往英国领事馆，如果领事馆能办好他的护照手续，他将留在上海，并在静安寺路1269号经营一家餐馆，前提是
